quote: After playing the Spiderman saga, which has two good games and one not so good, I expected more from this **** reality is that it was disappointing and forgettable.Programming errors, generic missions, wasting the character with a poorly written plot and graphics inferior to those from a couple of years ago, as well as very poorly developed game mechanics

author: GamerM-M
quote: The graphics are excellent and the world is impressive, although I notice that some of the "essence" has been lost; I don't experience the same freedom as before. The progress is extremely slow, the story doesn't engage me, and, again, I feel there are more restrictions compared to the freedom provided by the previous ones; I don't know if it's due to some kind of woksism—inclusion is noticeable—or if they simply wanted to alter the experience. The missions are repetitive and end up getting boring after a while. Technically, there are some glitches and drops in fps, but nothing unusual. Having good graphics doesn't guarantee a good game: you can just consider Minecraft, Cuphead, or Silkson; as a gamer, this doesn't seem enjoyable to me.
